specification.problem: Reconstruct a universal quantum computation scheme using spinless interacting bosonic quantum walkers on a piecewise-constant graph governed by the 2D Bose-Hubbard model, with qubits encoded in walker positions, X/Z rotations, cphase and swap gates, with vertex count linear in qubit number.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Abstract-level reconstruction only: Bose-Hubbard Hamiltonian background, position encoding, and gate set (X/Z rotations, cphase, swap). Graph geometry, couplings, timings, Steane-code encoding and optical-lattice details are not given in the abstract. Steps and measurement are plausible placeholders, not the paper's protocol.

equations.description: Target gates: arbitrary X and Z rotations plus an entangling cphase (swap also provided).
equations.abstract_quote: Arbitrary X and Z rotations are constructed, as well as an entangling two-qubit cphase gate and a swap gate.
equations.justification: Gate families are stated in the abstract; matrix forms are standard. The cphase angle (pi) is assumed.

specification.initial_state: Assumed: each walker localized at a designated vertex encoding logical |0>; the abstract gives no details.

steps.description: Place one walker per qubit on its assigned vertices of the piecewise-constant graph, encoding logical basis states by position.
Implement single-qubit R_X and R_Z rotations by evolving under H with tuned piecewise-constant hopping/potentials for suitable durations (parameters not given).
Implement CPHASE between two walkers via on-site interaction U when they meet (assumed mechanism), and swap via routing; timings unspecified.
Compose gates into circuits, optionally with error-correcting encodings such as the Steane code (details not in abstract).

specification.measurement: Single-qubit measurement with localized operators: read out which vertex (site occupation n_i) the walker occupies, giving the computational-basis outcome. Exact detection mechanism not given; X-basis measurement would follow a rotation.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Assumed minimal: map occupation outcomes to logical bits; for the Steane code, compute syndromes classically and apply corrections. Details not in abstract.
assumptions: Standard Bose-Hubbard form used as a placeholder
CPHASE arises from on-site interaction when walkers meet (assumed)
Measurement is occupation readout of position
